adversarial_repairs.counterexample: NetworkPolicy podSelector uses NotIn for a key absent from the ClayVerse Pod. Kubernetes selector semantics still select that Pod, so excluding the absent key can hide an additive broad policy.
adversarial_repairs.repair: NotIn rejects only when the key exists and the live label value is in the excluded set.
adversarial_repairs.regressions: absent-key NotIn broad egress fails closed; absent-key NotIn empty egress appears in the selecting-policy inventory

adversarial_repairs.counterexample: A Kubernetes securityContext, RuntimeClass, NetworkPolicy object, or caller-supplied annotation expectation is declarative/expected state and can be overinterpreted as independently reviewed runtime enforcement.
adversarial_repairs.repair: v3 explicitly distinguishes caller-supplied expectations, observed Kubernetes snapshot/declarative state, and still-unobserved external/runtime acceptance evidence.

snapshot_scope.image: expected digest must match Pod spec and observed runtime imageID; acceptance authority for the expectation remains external
snapshot_scope.runtime_class: RuntimeClass object/handler and Pod selection are recorded; they do not prove current-supported Kata version/configuration or independent VM identity
snapshot_scope.guest_kernel: in-guest uname must differ from node kernel; this is a discriminator only and is not promoted to independent guest-boundary proof
snapshot_scope.pod_security: declared host-namespace, ServiceAccount, seccomp, non-root, uid/gid, read-only-root, privilege and capability profile is fenced; active enforcement still required
snapshot_scope.persistence: fsGroup plus exact two PVC/PV/StorageClass/CSIDriver identities are recorded; non-root create/write/fsync/read/rename/delete still requires active before/after-replacement proof
snapshot_scope.health: declared readiness /readyz and liveness /healthz remain distinct
snapshot_scope.network: all selecting NetworkPolicies are enumerated and hashed under supported LabelSelector semantics; canonical default-deny is required; obvious broad allows and malformed peer types fail closed; external policy review, CNI identity and active enforcement remain open
snapshot_scope.kata_annotations: effective post-admission io.katacontainers.* annotations must equal a caller-supplied expected set; that set is not itself treated as proof of independent security review
snapshot_scope.tier2: Pod UID is observed; sandbox/VM identity and full replacement are not
